hello.speaker: ilatea
hello.text: I am Ilatea. Small things matter: walk to a door and step inside.

keys.speaker: ilatea
keys.text: Walk with {key:up} {key:left} {key:down} {key:right}, or tap where you want to go. {key:menu} opens the menu.

fewer.speaker: ilatea
fewer.text: Fewer hints it is. The menu can call me back.
